channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dwight Howard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dwight Howard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Dwight Howard
item.description:
However, Shaq overheard what Howard had to say and responded, claiming he didn't care about the former Orlando Magic star.

“Dwight Howard, the fact u think I care about u is funny, but I won't ever bring your name up again sensitive big man, a jokester that can't take a joke. Won't ever say your name again ever again. Have a great day, and now u have been deleted. Have a great day,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Dwight Howard, Jan 7, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Danny Green on Dwight Howard
item.description:
“We spoke about this a couple times on Dwight Howard’s podcast and a bunch of other people’s podcasts,”

Danny Green on Dwight Howard, Dec 16, 2024. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Udonis:

“A lot of people don't know this. You know what I'm saying? The first incident that I had with Dwight was he elbowed me in the ear, and bust my eardrum, I had a perforated eardrum. And from that point on, every time I played that motherfucker it was on. It was on. Somebody was going to get fucked up, either me or you, but you done bust my m***** eardrum… you can’t get me and I don’t get you back.”

Udonis Haslem on Dwight Howard, Feb 13, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Dwyane Wade on Dwight Howard being snubbed from NBA 75

“When you talk about these last 25 years, how many names can you think of and Dwight Howard’s name is not in there? And I know T-Mac should be in and other great players but Dwight Howard one for me was tough”

Dwyane Wade on Dwight Howard, Sep 24, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: John Salley on Dwight Howard
item.description:
John Salley on Dwight Howard:

“He’s the best thing EVER to come out of Atlanta. I love that cat. He was so smart about what he did in Taiwan. This is what’s funny: China is very, very, VERY important to the NBA and for him to play in Taiwan while they’re having their little spiff going on is simple. But I really think that Dwight improved his understanding of this world by going over and playing in another place. He embraced it and was showing his charismatic way of being, I think it was a really good move on his part.”

John Salley on Dwight Howard, Aug 29, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Troy Daniels on Dwight Howard
item.description:
“What’s the most amazing part is his frame. No disrespect to him, but his frame is not like a Dwight Howard frame. It’s more of a lazy type of frame … where he doesn’t have muscles.”

Troy Daniels on Dwight Howard, Jul 29, 2023. Source: Roanoke Times.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Wade says on the Club Shay Shay podcast.

“I know a lot of people have a lot of things to say about Dwight Howard, his personality or whatever people like to take a shot at. But when it comes to that man’s actual work, his body of work, it’s undeniable. He took that team to the Finals. You can pick a lot of guys to be on this team, it’s all subjective. But when you’re talking about this generation, these last 25 years, how many names can you think of where Dwight Howard is not in there?”

Dwyane Wade on Dwight Howard, Jun 14, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker
item.description:
“I feel like I was on the edge of kinda getting pushed out myself. If I wasn’t a true professional last year and the Clippers didn’t give me a chance, I don’t know if I’d probably been here right now. “We have so many great guys that can be like (Carmelo Anthony), Dwight [Howard], … even Kemba Walker. … You need veteran guys to help these young teams out as much as possible.”

John Wall on Carmelo Anthony, Dwight Howard, Kemba Walker, Nov 19, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Anthony Davis on team's chemistry:

“In house, what we do in the locker room and what we say, we keep it to ourselves. After the situation, me and DH [Dwight Howard] talked about it, and we left it at that.”

Anthony Davis on Dwight Howard, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Anthony Davis
item.description:
Frank Vogel on the Dwight Howard/Anthony Davis spat:

“Those guys love each other. … I’d rather our guys care than not care”

Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Anthony Davis, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Rajon Rondo on AD and Dwight Howard:

“Those two guys, I wouldn’t say they’re best friends, but they get along very well.”

Rajon Rondo on Dwight Howard, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Wayne Ellington on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Ellington on LAL’s potential defense behind its guards:

“When you have the length and size that this team has … you have help all over the court. You got forces like AD and Dwight back there swatting stuff around.”

Wayne Ellington on Dwight Howard, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Dwight Howard
item.description:
“Dwight plays the way Dwight plays, and it was just a conversation between me and him that I just wanted to make it clear that the throwing down and the swinging of the elbows and things like that, I just felt like we should kind of leave that out of the game for tonight. I think he kind of disagreed, so when he disagreed, I disagreed, and there was a whole bunch of disagreeing.”

Udonis Haslem on Dwight Howard, May 14, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“First of all, [the Sixers] have an advantage coaching-wise based on experience with [head coach Doc Rivers], in terms of championship experience that [Green has], that Dwight [Howard] has. And the ambition of Ben [Simmons] and Joel [Embiid], these guys are hungry now, they’ve been a part of what they call ‘The Process’ for several years, and it’s time for The Process to bear some fruit. I’m betting my money on Philly… Ws mean confidence. It’s not cool to be overconfident, but it’s very cool to be confident. So you need to maintain that confidence and get out there and perform, that’s the way I see it.”

Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Apr 9, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Chris Paul, Dwight Howard, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I loved working together on how to get his incredible Hall of Fame teammates Dwight Howard, Chris Paul, and Russell Westbrook to the Rockets. I will be rooting for James to win a championship in Houston. It's how this story should end.”

Daryl Morey on Chris Paul, Dwight Howard, Russell Westbrook, Oct 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Dwight Howard
item.description:
“You look at [Rajon Rondo], he’s 10 years removed from his last Finals, and Dwight [Howard] is 11 years out. I don’t want that to happen to me. I want to be here. I came to Los Angeles to contend for championships and I’ve put in the work to do so.”

Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Dwight Howard, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Bam Adebayo on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Miami's Bam Adebayo on facing off with the AD and Dwight Howard:

“They're shot blockers. That's one thing they're gifted with, shot-blocking. Not letting them off the hook, just staying aggressive... keep staying my style of basketball.”

Bam Adebayo on Dwight Howard, Sep 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Javale McGee
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Vogel on Howard and McGee:

“Those guys have done a great job all season of partnering up to man the center position… this is a matchup where it favors us to flip flop the roles and (have Dwight start).”

Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Javale McGee, Sep 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: LeBron James on Dwight Howard
item.description:
LeBron James on Dwight Howard:

“Dwight was phenomenal for the minutes he played. He got us extra shots when we were missing early on. We needed that out of him. It was vintage him. He’s been a league leader in rebounds for a lot of times in his career.”

LeBron James on Dwight Howard, Sep 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Mark Medina:Lakers forward Kyle Kuzma on Dwight Howard:

“He has been a great teammate ... He has no ego. He has just been focused on one common goal.”

Kyle Kuzma on Dwight Howard, Jul 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Amid protests the past month, begun after George Floyd died while in police custody in Minneapolis, Howard has said publicly he may sit out the season to help ongoing efforts to address racial inequality.

“We are going to continue to work through those extenuating circumstances with Dwight, support him, support his 6-year-old son and hope for the best that he would be a part of our roster in Orlando,”

Rob Pelinka on Dwight Howard, Jul 1, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Jameer Nelson on Dwight Howard
item.description:
“Every day when we came in, it was about Dwight wanting to be traded and about Dwight wanting Stan to be fired and things like that,”

Jameer Nelson on Dwight Howard, Dec 9, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jameer Nelson on Dwight Howard
item.description:
“Every day when we came in,it was about Dwight wanting to be traded and about Dwight wanting Stan [Van Gundy] to be fired and things like that,”

Jameer Nelson on Dwight Howard, Dec 9, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Kevin Love on LeBron James, Dwight Howard, Anthony Davis
item.description:
“Once he gets up to speed and other guys get up to speed, they’re really going to be rolling and they’re already clicking as it is with LeBron and [Anthony Davis].Dwight [Howard] has really played well too. They’re a fun team to watch. Any team with LeBron is going to be a fun team to watch, but he’s leading them and he has been super efficient. There are nights where he’s going to have 30, 15 and 15 and then there’s nights where he’s going to play at his own pace and not put up those numbers, but he’s just so efficient. It doesn’t look like he’s lost a step as he gets older in this league. He continues to get smarter and find ways to make everything work.”

Kevin Love on LeBron James, Dwight Howard, Anthony Davis, Nov 17, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: LeBron James on Dwight Howard
item.description:
LeBron on Howard:

“Dwight Howard was huge. Every minute that he played, it was a great performance by him, crashing the glass, catching lobs, and getting great strips defensively,and giving us extra possessions. He was vintage tonight.”

LeBron James on Dwight Howard, Nov 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard:

“I’m definitely confident he can the play we’ve laid out for him. He’s coming to the Lakers at a very different time in his career.[The] first time he was here, he was on top of the NBA mountain and was a bonafide superstar. Things have changed, he’s later in his career now, he’s a different person, has a different mindset…”

Frank Vogel on Dwight Howard, Sep 1, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard's progress:

“We’re in no rush. When he’s ready to play, he’s ready to play. Hopefully, it’s this season.”

Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Feb 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Brooks on Howard seeing a nerve specialist in LA:

“We’ll know more information in the next couple of days...[the injury] hasn’t gotten much better in the last couple of days.”

Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Nov 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Thomas Bryant
item.description:
Fred Katz:Brooks on Thomas Bryant's minutes if Howard starts and gets regular playing time:

“I don't know where we'll find him minutes off the bench but we'll tryto make something happen.”

Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Thomas Bryant, Nov 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard:

“I like his smile. He's a good-looking guy,and he uses it all the time.”

Scott Brooks on Dwight Howard, Nov 4, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.
